exposure: left ventricular (LV) early diastolic strain rate
outcome: Left ventricular (LV) and right ventricular systolic and diastolic function
cohort: 70 babies with Down syndrome and 60 control infants
finding: In infants with Down syndrome, LV early diastolic strain rate is independently associated with measures of pulmonary hypertension.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was considered as a variable but there were no reported findings on mode of delivery and pulmonary hypertension.
